title: Db2 ASN capture needs a set start order
symptom: VALUES ASNCDC.ASNCDCSERVICES('start', ...) through ibm-db never returned; later, captured tables had no change rows
cause: The UDF starts the agent and stays attached to it when called from a driver; registrations are read when the agent starts
effect: Debezium sees no changes from tables that look registered
fix: Start asncap as the instance user (detached), register tables with ADDTABLE, then asnccmd reinit
